source_text: Welcome, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: LlFlOp#.Welcome, 1Hero.

source_text: 1Hero!

structure.raw_value: JuShClNo1#.1Hero!

source_text: Let Judy go!...

structure.raw_value: McMaAgNo1.Let Judy go!...

source_text: Heh…

structure.raw_value: LlFlDe.Heh…

source_text: Lillian?

structure.raw_value: McShClNo1.Lillian?

source_text: What’s wrong? You don’t recognize me?

structure.raw_value: LlFlEx.What’s wrong? You don’t recognize me?

translation: Coś nie tak? Nie poznajesz mnie?

source_text: What happened to you? Who are you?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.What happened to you? Who are you?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.What happened to you? Who are you?"

translation: Co ci się stało? Kim jesteś?

source_text: We should fuck his brains out!

structure.raw_value: D1HaEx.We should fuck his brains out!

source_text: That won’t be necessary.

structure.raw_value: LlFlDe.That won’t be necessary.

source_text: Father Solomon will come here; and when he does, you’ll be sorry.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Father Solomon will come here; and when he does, you’ll be sorry.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Father Solomon will come here; and when he does, you’ll be sorry."

translation: Ojciec Solomon tu przyjdzie, a wtedy pożałujesz.

source_text: Let us have her, Mother.

structure.raw_value: D2FlOp#.Let us have her, Mother.

source_text: Please! I want to taste the woman of God.

structure.raw_value: D3SaOp.Please! I want to taste the woman of God.
structure.script_literal: "D3SaOp.Please! I want to taste the woman of God."

source_text: Of course we will leave her alone. She will suffer no harm.

structure.raw_value: LlFrEx.Of course we will leave her alone. She will suffer no harm.
structure.script_literal: "LlFrEx.Of course we will leave her alone. She will suffer no harm."

translation: Oczywiście zostawimy ją w spokoju. Nic złego jej się nie stanie.

source_text: 1Hero, you must not allow the priest near here again.

structure.raw_value: LlAnEx#.1Hero, you must not allow the priest near here again.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnEx#.1Hero, you must not allow the priest near here again."

translation: 1Hero, nie możesz pozwolić, by ten ksiądz znów się tu zbliżył.

source_text: You’re afraid of him.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.You’re afraid of him.

source_text: He wants the nun to return home safely, as I’m sure you do as well.

structure.raw_value: LlBaEx.He wants the nun to return home safely, as I’m sure you do as well.
structure.script_literal: "LlBaEx.He wants the nun to return home safely, as I’m sure you do as well."

translation: Chce, by zakonnica bezpiecznie wróciła do domu. Ty pewnie też tego chcesz.

source_text: You have the Toma. I gave you what you needed, now let Judy go.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You have the Toma. I gave you what you needed, now let Judy go.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You have the Toma. I gave you what you needed, now let Judy go."

translation: Masz Tomę. Dałam ci to, czego potrzebowałeś, więc puść Judy.

source_text: Look around you, 1Hero. This is the world that we’ve called home since time began.

structure.raw_value: LlBaEx#.Look around you, 1Hero. This is the world that we’ve called home since time began.
structure.script_literal: "LlBaEx#.Look around you, 1Hero. This is the world that we’ve called home since time began."

translation: Rozejrzyj się, 1Hero. To świat, który nazywamy domem od zarania dziejów.

source_text: It sucks… I get it.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.It sucks… I get it.

source_text: Your world was given a false mother. The God of your world took everything away from me…

structure.raw_value: LlAnEx.Your world was given a false mother. The God of your world took everything away from me…
structure.script_literal: "LlAnEx.Your world was given a false mother. The God of your world took everything away from me…"

translation: Wasz świat dostał fałszywą matkę. Bóg tego świata odebrał mi wszystko…

source_text: It’s time to end the torment.

structure.raw_value: LlSaOp.It’s time to end the torment.

source_text: I am Lilith, the true mother of humanity.

structure.raw_value: LlFrEx#.I am Lilith, the true mother of humanity.
structure.script_literal: "LlFrEx#.I am Lilith, the true mother of humanity."

source_text: Lilith? Sounds familiar.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Lilith? Sounds familiar.

source_text: Your mind is pure, uninfected by the religions of your world.

structure.raw_value: LlFrEx.Your mind is pure, uninfected by the religions of your world.
structure.script_literal: "LlFrEx.Your mind is pure, uninfected by the religions of your world."

translation: Twój umysł jest czysty, nieskażony religiami tego świata.

source_text: You are here for a reason. I believe you can see the good in my plan.

structure.raw_value: LlFrEx.You are here for a reason. I believe you can see the good in my plan.
structure.script_literal: "LlFrEx.You are here for a reason. I believe you can see the good in my plan."

translation: Jesteś tu nie bez powodu. Wierzę, że dostrzeżesz dobro w moim planie.

source_text: Your plan?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Your plan?

source_text: Humans will be given a choice. I am not a ruler; I am a mother.

structure.raw_value: LlFrEx.Humans will be given a choice. I am not a ruler; I am a mother.
structure.script_literal: "LlFrEx.Humans will be given a choice. I am not a ruler; I am a mother."

translation: Ludzie dostaną wybór. Nie jestem władczynią, lecz matką.

source_text: What choice?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.What choice?

source_text: To be returned to their God or to live a life of pleasure on Earth.

structure.raw_value: LlFlEx.To be returned to their God or to live a life of pleasure on Earth.
structure.script_literal: "LlFlEx.To be returned to their God or to live a life of pleasure on Earth."

translation: Mogą wrócić do swojego Boga albo wieść na Ziemi życie pełne rozkoszy.

source_text: You’re making an army. Duncan’s men are dead.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You’re making an army. Duncan’s men are dead.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You’re making an army. Duncan’s men are dead."

translation: Tworzysz armię. Ludzie Duncana nie żyją.

source_text: Oh, 1Hero. Those men are not God’s people…

structure.raw_value: LlFrEx.Oh, 1Hero. Those men are not God’s people…
structure.script_literal: "LlFrEx.Oh, 1Hero. Those men are not God’s people…"

translation: Och, 1Hero. Ci ludzie nie należą do Boga…

source_text: Their souls are here now. In Hell.

structure.raw_value: LlFlEx.Their souls are here now. In Hell.
structure.script_literal: "LlFlEx.Their souls are here now. In Hell."

translation: Ich dusze są teraz tutaj. W piekle.

source_text: And their bodies?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.And their bodies?

source_text: The demons of this world will now finally have the vessels they need to enter the paradise that is your world…

structure.raw_value: LlHaEx.The demons of this world will now finally have the vessels they need to enter the paradise that is your world…
structure.script_literal: "LlHaEx.The demons of this world will now finally have the vessels they need to enter the paradise that is your world…"

translation: Demony z tego świata wreszcie dostaną ciała, których potrzebują, by wkroczyć do raju, jakim jest wasz świat…

source_text: The God above looks down on us, but with my guiding hand, paradise can be ours.

structure.raw_value: LlFrEx.The God above looks down on us, but with my guiding hand, paradise can be ours.
structure.script_literal: "LlFrEx.The God above looks down on us, but with my guiding hand, paradise can be ours."

translation: Bóg z góry patrzy na nas z wysoka, ale pod moim przewodnictwem raj może należeć do nas.

source_text: You’re going to upend our civilization? No one’s going to want to do that.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You’re going to upend our civilization? No one’s going to want to do that.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You’re going to upend our civilization? No one’s going to want to do that."

translation: Chcesz wywrócić naszą cywilizację do góry nogami? Nikt tego nie poprze.

source_text: Heh. You have no idea of the world I intend to create… I will show everyone what they’ve been missing.

structure.raw_value: LlFlDe.Heh. You have no idea of the world I intend to create… I will show everyone what they’ve been missing.
structure.script_literal: "LlFlDe.Heh. You have no idea of the world I intend to create… I will show everyone what they’ve been missing."

translation: Heh. Nie masz pojęcia, jaki świat zamierzam stworzyć… Pokażę wszystkim, czego im brakowało.

source_text: What pleasure!

structure.raw_value: JuEcAg#.What pleasure!

source_text: There is so much more where that came from.

structure.raw_value: LlFlOp.There is so much more where that came from.
structure.script_literal: "LlFlOp.There is so much more where that came from."

source_text: Not so fast, Lilith!

structure.raw_value: BrAnOp.Not so fast, Lilith!

source_text: The pain!

structure.raw_value: D2HuCl.The pain!

source_text: Look away!

structure.raw_value: D3WoCl.Look away!

source_text: Father Solomon!

structure.raw_value: McShOpNo1.Father Solomon!

source_text: Get back! Sister Judy is ours!

structure.raw_value: LlMaAgNo1.Get back! Sister Judy is ours!

translation: Cofnij się! Siostra Judy należy do nas!

source_text: Not today, demon!

structure.raw_value: BrAnOp.Not today, demon!
